outcome: time to reach target pulse oxygen saturations (SpO2) > 70%
time to reach target pulse oxygen saturations (SpO2) > 90%
sensitivity and specificity of pink color of tongue and trunk to predict SpO2 > 70%
cohort: This study included 352 term and preterm neonates not requiring any intervention at birth.
finding: Preterm neonates have lower saturation at birth and take longer than term neonates to achieve an SpO2 > 70%, whilst the median time required to attain > 90% SpO2 is same for all neonates.
